body:
## Outcome

Give React and RN components a small, composable API with consistent semantics and platform-appropriate rendering.

Roadmap: #1 · Milestone: M2: React and React Native components · Priority: P0 (required for v1).

## Scope

- Define controlled/uncontrolled state, stable IDs, refs, event composition, variants, density, disabled/busy semantics, and escape hatches without adopting the whole shadcn API.
- Implement platform providers for tokens/theme, density, typography, locale/direction, reduced motion, and an optional feedback interface.
- Preserve native component props, web semantic element selection, handler cancellation, and focus behavior; compose children where useful without excessive wrappers.
- Keep provider state scoped to the consuming app/root; browser/native APIs initialize at appropriate lifecycle boundaries and component use without feedback is supported.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Equivalent React and RN examples share documented behavioral contracts while exposing only platform-supported props.
- [ ] SSR output and hydration are deterministic, Metro imports are platform safe, and nested providers cannot leak preferences/state into unrelated roots.
- [ ] Controlled/uncontrolled state, forwarded refs, canceled handlers, disabled/busy controls, and provider updates have meaningful tests.
- [ ] Importing base components does not require audio, haptics, charts, or a complete provider stack.

## Prerequisites

- #10 — Establish accessibility, localization, and platform behavior standards

## References

- [App](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/apps/app/src/components/ui)
- [Pro](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/apps/pro/src/components/ui)
- [Native](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/ui-native)
- [Font](https://github.com/bloxwap/font/tree/main/apps/docs)

## Completion evidence

Link implementation PRs, updated docs/examples, and relevant validation results. Record platform limitations and any remaining catalog/adoption work explicitly.
title: Implement shared component contracts and platform providers
